_comment: Editorial decisions the pipeline applies. Automated checks propose; a named owner decides. Each decision records why.

excluded_source_types.community: Unverified user-generated content; useful only as a signal of which myths to correct.
excluded_source_types.partner_scraped: Commercial partner page scraped without a content agreement; biased and not reviewable.
excluded_source_types.mirror_scraped: Third-party copy of another source; always index the original.

D12.why: Crisis resources: an error here is the worst possible failure.

D23.why: The assistant's own data policy; answers about privacy must match it exactly.

D03.decision: Says GI Bill benefits expire after 15 years for everyone (D02: no expiry if last discharge on/after 2013-01-01) and tells users to apply via eBenefits/DS Logon (D06: being retired). Also asserts '~30 days' processing with no source.

D07.decision: Directs users to eBenefits/DS Logon to track claims; D06 says those sign-ins are being retired and claim status lives on VA.gov.
